name: Crash Bar / Double Door Tool (DDT)
description: Double doors with crash bars (panic hardware) often have a gap between the two door leafs that can be exploited. The DDT is inserted into this gap to depress the crash bar or manipulate the latch from outside. This technique bypasses the deadbolt or cylinder entirely on many commercial double-door configurations and is particularly effective on secondary entry points like emergency exits and stairwell doors where double-door panic hardware is standard.

blue.det: Tool visible between door leafs; door open alert; camera footage of exterior approach.
blue.cm: Door edge guards reducing gap between leafs; door alarms; camera coverage; astragal (overlapping door edge) prevents access to gap.
